def fruit_distribution(s, n):
    def extract_count(s):
        counts = s.split()
        apples = int(counts[0])
        oranges = int(counts[3])
        return apples, oranges

    def calculate_total_fruits(apples, oranges):
        return apples + oranges

    def calculate_mangoes(total_fruits, n):
        return n - total_fruits

    apples, oranges = extract_count(s)
    total_fruits = calculate_total_fruits(apples, oranges)
    mangoes = calculate_mangoes(total_fruits, n)

    return mangoes
